FTIRealSpaceEntanglementEntropyParticlePartition, version 0.01

Usage: FTIRealSpaceEntanglementEntropyParticlePartition [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --ground-file : name of the file corresponding to the ground state of the whole system
    --degenerated-groundstate : single column file describing a degenerated ground state
    --min-na : minimum size of the particles whose entropy has to be evaluated (default value = 1)
    --max-na : maximum size of the particles whose entropy has to be evaluated (0 if equal to half the total system size) (default value = 0)
    --min-sza : minimum value of sz in a subsystem (default value = -1000)
    --max-sza : maximum value of sz in a subsystem (default value = 1000)
    --show-time : show time required for each operation
    --decoupled : assume that the total spin is a good quantum number of the problem
    --hofstadter : the file name uses Hofstadter model convention
    --su2-spin : particles have a SU(2) spin
    --selected-blocks : provide a column formatted ascii file that indicates which block of the reduced density matrix should be computed
    --exclusion-file : name of the file that describes an exclusion principle (beyond the gutzwiller projection)

output options:
    -o, --output-file : use this file name instead of the one that can be deduced from the input file name (replacing the vec extension with partent extension
    --density-matrix : store the eigenvalues of the partial density matrices in the a given file
    --density-eigenstate : compute the eigenstates of the reduced density matrix
    --na-eigenstate : compute the eigenstates of the reduced density matrix only for a subsystem with a fixed total Na value (default value = 0)
    --sza-eigenstate : compute the eigenstates of the reduced density matrix only for a subsystem with a fixed total Sza value (default value = 0)
    --nbr-eigenstates : number of reduced density matrix eigenstates to compute (0 if all) (default value = 0)
    --import-densitymatrix : read a single block of the reduced density matrix from a file and process it
    --export-densitymatrix : write a single block of the reduced density matrix from a file and exit

tools options:
    --use-lapack : use LAPACK libraries instead of DiagHam libraries

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode

    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

misc options:
